prompt: Implement a modular Real-Time Chat Server in C# with three isolated components: (1) TCP Connection Manager handling client handshakes and keep-alive heartbeats, (2) Room Management Subsystem supporting channel creation, broadcasting, and user permission roles, and (3) Message Persistence Engine asynchronously buffering chat history to a relational store.

criterion_scores.name: Module 1 Connection Score
criterion_scores.justification: Implements inbound PING/PONG handling and connection lifecycle but lacks an outgoing heartbeat timer to periodically send PINGs and detect stale peers.

criterion_scores.name: Module 2 Room Score
criterion_scores.justification: Defines a thread-safe Room model using ConcurrentDictionary but omits the concrete RoomManager implementation and broadcast logic needed for efficient messaging.

criterion_scores.name: Module 3 Persistence Score
criterion_scores.justification: Provides the persistence interface but omits the background batching mechanism and queue‑safe implementation required for asynchronous, reliable storage.

criterion_scores.name: System Integration Score
criterion_scores.justification: Shows clear interface‑based decoupling and a logical project layout, though it does not display the actual composition root wiring that ties the modules together.
